admission.justification: Runtime table and role instructions prevent a successful turn being misreported as accepted task, semantic curation or Git publication.

applicability: Execution lifecycle projection of a role launch receipt and role doctrine interpreting it.
conditions: An unmarked receipt keeps the original completed/starting projection.
The prepared-start refusal projection requires both the leaf's closing mark and `leafArchive.startRefused` true; a closing mark whose settlement has not set that flag leaves the ordinary status.
exclusions: Semantic acceptance, requirement satisfaction, memory publication and Git landing remain owner judgments.
statement: `canStart` and `canRetry` keep the meaning the launch leaf gave them and are computed from the receipt's status; no refresh touches an unresolved receipt; a finished turn is recorded as `completed` with the detail 'last turn finished; the agent is idle' and changes no AR task, review, requirement or Git state. A receipt that carries its leaf's closing mark and whose `leafArchive.startRefused` flag is true is the exception: `canStart`, `canRevive` and `canRetry` are false, the explicit `startRefused` flag is projected, and the status is `rejected` when the receipt's own target is already archived or gone; a marked receipt whose settlement has not set that flag keeps its ordinary status.
